questions.question: What was the reported loss ratio for Delta Dental of Washington in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wa_oic_dental_loss_ratios.csv')
row = df[(df['Company Name'] == 'Delta Dental of Washington') & (df['Year'] == 2024)]
result = int(row['Dental Loss Ratio'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Did UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company report more than one billion dollars in dental claims payments in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wa_oic_dental_loss_ratios.csv')
row = df[(df['Company Name'] == 'UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company') & (df['Year'] == 2024)]
payments = row['Dental Payments'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if payments > 1_000_000_000 else 'no'
